---
title: "Baby Names Analysis"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

names_df <- read_csv(
  "ssa-baby-names.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    year = col_integer(),
    name = col_character(),
    sex = col_character(),
    count = col_integer()
  )
)
```

```{r}
names_df |>
  filter(name == "David") |>
  summarize(count = sum(count), .by = year) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = count)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "steelblue") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "Popularity of the Name 'David' in the U.S. (1880–2025)",
    subtitle = "Annual number of babies named David recorded by the Social Security Administration",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Social Security Administration"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
